Who We Are

More Than a Gym.
A Grappling Community.

We believe that the mat is the ultimate equalizer. It doesn't matter if you're a complete beginner or a seasoned competitor — we are passionate about grappling in all formats and we have a passion for teaching and building the next generation of grapplers.

Located in the south of Mallorca, our academy brings competitive-level BJJ to the island.

Classes

What We Offer

From your very first class to the podium — there is a place for you on our mat.

01

Gi & No-Gi Classes

No experience needed. Build a solid BJJ foundation — positions, escapes, submissions — in a safe, welcoming environment. The perfect first step on the mat.

All Levels 02

For Competitors

Deepen your understanding of the gentle art. Complex concepts, live drilling, and high-intensity sparring for experienced grapplers chasing technical mastery.

Blue Belt + 03

Kids Classes

Fun, safe, and confidence-building. We teach kids the fundamentals of BJJ — discipline, respect, and self-defence — in a supportive environment they'll love.
